items.title: Trainspotting: The Musical Cancels UK Tour After Poor Ticket Sales
items.summary: Trainspotting: The Musical has canceled its planned UK tour after poor ticket sales, including a reported 19% sales capacity for its opening Edinburgh engagement.

items.title: Music Director Admits Faking Threats That Shut Down ‘Rocky Horror’ Production
items.summary: Police say the music director of a community theatre production of The Rocky Horror Show admitted to faking threatening messages to himself in an effort to leave the show. The fabricated threats led the theatre to cancel the production.

items.title: Maine Theater Patrons Still Waiting for Refunds After Canceled Summer Season
items.summary: Theater at Monmouth canceled its entire summer season and promised refunds. Nearly two months later, some patrons say they’re still waiting for their money and clear answers from the theatre.

items.title: Boy George Exits ‘Jesus Christ Superstar’ Following Backlash Over AI-Assisted Pro-Israel Song
items.summary: Boy George has withdrawn from Jesus Christ Superstar days after releasing a controversial AI-assisted pro-Israel song.

items.title: Actor and Theatre Teacher Indicted on Federal Child-Exploitation Charges
items.summary: South Carolina actor and theatre teacher Jonathan Andrew Monk has been indicted on federal child-exploitation charges.

items.title: Did Pressure From a City Council Member Lead to a Theater Teacher’s Resignation?
items.summary: A New Albany theater teacher resigned in May. Now parents, students, alumni, and an attorney are asking whether complaints from a City Council member influenced the decision.

items.title: Duke of York’s Theatre to Be Renamed in Honor of Tom Stoppard
items.summary: Tom Stoppard’s name belongs in the West End. Now it will be there permanently, as the Duke of York’s Theatre is set to be renamed in his honor.

items.title: Broadway Cleaners Union Votes to Authorize Strike
items.summary: Broadway cleaners have voted to authorize a strike amid ongoing contract negotiations with the Broadway League. No strike date has been announced, but the vote marks a major escalation as workers push for a new agreement.

items.title: Arena Stage Artistic Director Hana S. Sharif Steps Down Amid Reported Board Tensions
items.summary: A major leadership shakeup at Arena Stage is raising questions about the future of one of the country’s most important regional theatres.

items.title: Refugee-Themed Play Pulled from French Theatre Program After Far-Right Mayor Takes Office
items.summary: A play about migration and asylum was scheduled for a municipal theatre in France. Then a far-right mayor took office, and the show was pulled.

items.title: Former Theatre Instructor Sentenced to Eight Life Sentences for Child Sexual Abuse
items.summary: A former theatre instructor in Oklahoma has been sentenced to eight life terms after being convicted on all eight counts of child sexual abuse involving a former student.

items.title: Washington National Opera Takes Kennedy Center to Court Over Disputed Funds
items.summary: The WNO-Kennedy Center split just got a lot messier. Washington National Opera is now suing over more than $17 million in disputed funds, including money it says was meant for the opera company.

items.title: U.K. Tour Stop of ‘Mean Girls’ Canceled Amid Racist Unrest
items.summary: The UK tour of Mean Girls canceled its Belfast run amid racist unrest in Northern Ireland. Vivian Panka, the first Black actress to play Regina George in the tour, says she has been afraid to leave her house.

items.title: Two Former Theatre Educators Sentenced in Separate Child Abuse and Exploitation Cases
items.summary: Two former theatre educators connected to youth and school theatre programs have now been sentenced in separate child abuse and exploitation cases. One was sentenced to federal prison. Another was sentenced to probation and lifetime sex offender registration.

items.title: Baltimore Theatre Faces Allegations of Discriminatory Treatment Following ‘West Side Story’ Performance
items.summary: The Lyric Baltimore’s Board of Trustees has hired a law firm to investigate allegations of discriminatory treatment involving a Black patron and her son during a performance of West Side Story.

items.title: Pittsburgh Public Theater Staff Members Laid Off Amid Merger Preparation
items.summary: Several Pittsburgh Public Theater staff members were reportedly laid off the same day they returned from furlough — after already taking a pay cut and enduring weeks of uncertainty.

items.title: Scary Backstage Moment at ‘Beaches’ After Fan Sneaks Into Jessica Vosk’s Dressing Room
items.summary: A scary backstage moment at Broadway’s Beaches has raised serious questions about security at the Majestic Theatre after a fan reportedly entered Jessica Vosk’s dressing room without permission.

items.title: U.K. Theatre Group Cancels Dreamgirls After Rights Pulled Over Predominantly White Cast
items.summary: A U.K. theatre group’s Dreamgirls has been canceled after the rights were pulled following backlash over its practically all-white principal cast.

items.title: Canadian Theatre Defends Production After Students Removed From Matinee Performance
items.summary: A student matinee at a Canadian theatre has sparked public responses from both the theatre and the school after teachers removed students from a performance of Little Red Warrior and His Lawyer. The controversy has raised questions about content warnings and how theatres and schools communicate before students enter the audience.
